title: 第28章：你们以为赚了，但我只会赚的更多
novel_title: 穿越两界，我在80年代当倒爷
content_zh:
“够了！”

    “人心不足蛇吞象，能让大家伙赚一笔就行。”

    “小超，你给我个数，具体能吃下多少斤，我马上开会让大家伙去山脚挖野菜。”

    “大队长。”

    “叫什么大队长，喊叔。”

    “王叔。”

    “这就对了。”

    王叔哈哈一笑，两人的关系快速拉近。

    “王叔，我并不反对你让大家伙去挖野菜，不过……我现在还拿不出这么多钱，你看……能不能先小批量收购一些野菜，等卖了钱之后，我在大量收购。”

    “嗯！”

    王援朝想都没想就答应下来，他也想看看马超说的到底是不是真的。

    “行，那就按你的意思来。”

    “不过咱们可先说好，等你卖掉第一批野菜后，我就让大家伙一起出动挖野菜。”

    马超想了想，等大姑父将手里那批紧俏货卖出去，拿到手的钱正好付野菜的货款，来得及。

    唯一的压力就是马超回到现代，如何将这批野菜全部卖出去。

    看来，等明天去了现代，就要想办法找出路了。
content_en:
"Enough!"

    "If people's hearts are not as good as snakes swallowing elephants, it's enough to make the big guys make a fortune."

    "Xiao Chao, give me a number, exactly how many kilograms you can eat, and I will call immediately to ask everyone to dig wild vegetables at the foot of the mountain."

    "Captain."

    "What's your name, captain? Uncle."

    "Uncle Wang."

    "That's right."

    Uncle Wang laughed, and the relationship between the two quickly became closer.

    "Uncle Wang, I don't object to you letting the big guys dig wild vegetables, but... I can't afford so much money right now. You see... can you buy some wild vegetables in small batches first? After selling them for money, I will buy them in large quantities."

    "Yeah!"

    Wang Yuanchao agreed without thinking. He also wanted to see if what Ma Chao said was true.

    "Okay, then do what you want."

    "But let's make an agreement first. After you sell the first batch of wild vegetables, I will ask everyone to go out to dig wild vegetables."

    Ma Chao thought for a while, and when his eldest uncle sold the in-demand goods, he would get enough money to pay for the wild vegetables, which was enough time.

    The only pressure is how Ma Chao can sell all these wild vegetables when he returns to modern times.

    It seems that when I go to Hyundai tomorrow, I will have to think of ways to find a way out.
title_en: Chapter 28: You think you made a profit, but I will only make more
